title: crusader kings ii
text: A Grand piece of work in the Grand Strategy Genre of Grand Strategy games...Humor aside, the game has a strong focus on managing relationships (especially amongst your vassals) and guiding your dynasty from the Dark Ages to the High Middle Ages. The "Sandbox" effect and replayability of Crusader Kings II is by far it's most prominent feature, no two play-throughs will ever be similar. The Scope and scale of the game, and it's gameplay depth have been greatly increased since it's launch by many well-priced "core expansions" (Sword of Islam, Old Gods, The Republic, Way of Life, and Horse Lords). Offering countless hours of replayability, a good level of gameplay depth, and a vibrant modding community, Crusader Kings II is probably (in my opinion) one of the best Strategy Games of all time.

title: crusader kings ii
text: I truly cannot recommend this game any less than I am about it, though I would like to try. It is highly inaccessible and deeply unintuitive. Most of the positive reviews, which I admit are in the majority, tend to to make everything sound far, far more interesting than this game is. To me, most of the fun is coming from the stories that the player is constructing in their review. I found it about impossible to affect any meaningful change in the game. I was looking forward to a game of subtle political intrigue, but Crusader Kings is just a dense historical interface that lacks any relatability or wothwhile gameplay. For the absolute life of me, I cannot see how this game can have ever been enjoyed by anyone. From the game itself to the DLC, Crusader Kings is a closed door. A majority of options that LOOK available in the main game, require further payments and the number of hours it must take to even be able to feel like you are having any change on the game, is entirely NOT worth it. Overall, this game is an unfathomable waste of time & money and I strongly recommend avoiding it. I know that there are many with a fanatical love of it, but you have to ask yourself - are you ready to invest hundreds of hours, just to be able to say you took part in a poorly animated historical retelling of European "politics". You're better than that and there are thousands of better games you could be playing right now.

title: crusader kings ii
text: This isn't a game that will suit everyone's tastes. It's a slow burner, mixing long term strategic planning with entertaining political intrigue and famaily dynasty dynamics. Play as a Christian count, a Muslim, Sultan, a Pagan emperor and everything in between. Its far more entertaining and rewarding to climb the ladder of power and influence over successive gnerations of your family, passing on what you've earned to your successor and trying to build on what you've already achieved. Be always on guard, threats can emerge from every corner, whether its a horde of invading mongols, a vassal leading a coaltition to overthrow you, or even a envious half-sibling with a desire for you're titles.... Every character is unique, every playthrough different, every family dynasty special. I've sunk a stupid amount of hours into this game, whole days have gone by and I've barely looked away, worrying that my family will befall some great misfortune if my attention wavers. Its so replayable, as you can so many people, cultures and religions, each with their own unique mechanics, and it never ceases to entertain. I can only imagine what it could have achieved with a bigger budget. I understand if this isn't your kind of game, but if you like grand strategies, RPG elements and aren't a grahphics snob, this is a game that I can't rate highly enough: Get it.
